header: कक्षा : चौथी    विषय: हिंदी    माह-अगस्त 2025    अंक- 40

blocks.label: प्रश्न 1.
blocks.instruction: दिए गए गद्यांश को पढ़कर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए|
blocks.notes: This is a seen passage, lightly adapted from पाठ 6 'जयपुर से पत्र' (ch6.txt lines ~24-31: आमेर का दुर्ग … उदयपुर जाएँगे). (क)-(ग) are short answers, and (ग) 'जयपुर किस राज्य की राजधानी है?' is general knowledge (राजस्थान). (घ) is विलोम ×2 (पुराना, दिन) and (ड) is समान अर्थ ×2 (विशाल, रात्रि), so each part = ½ when split. The printed label is '(ड)' (ड, not ङ).

blocks.label: प्रश्न 2.
blocks.instruction: नीचे दिए प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखिए|
blocks.printedMarks: per item: (1M) (1M) (1M) (2M) (1M); no block total printed
blocks.notes: Textbook questions. (क) अमर ने जयपुर में क्या- क्या देखा? (पाठ 6, a list answer, judgement). (ख) पिनकोड (पाठ 6 box: छह अंक). (ग) हीरों की जाँच (पाठ 7: जौहरी). (घ) 2M: why the king gave the reward for the fake diamonds (पाठ 7, reasoning). (ड) why उदयपुर is called झीलों का नगर (inference / general knowledge; पाठ 6 अनुमान question). The block total is not printed and is derived as 1+1+1+2+1 = 6.

blocks.label: प्रश्न 3.
blocks.instruction: अमर ने अपने पिता को पत्र में 'सादर प्रणाम' लिखा। सोचिए वह क्या लिखता यदि वह -
blocks.notes: These are letter greetings (अभिवादन) for a friend and for a teacher, and several answers are acceptable (प्रिय मित्र / नमस्ते / सप्रेम नमस्ते; आदरणीय / सादर नमस्ते / सादर प्रणाम). Uses straight quotes as printed. The instruction is printed across two lines.

blocks.label: प्रश्न 4.
blocks.instruction: दिए गए अधूरे वाक्यों को पूरा करो|
blocks.notes: Sentence completion: 'हमने झूम -झूमकर ____' and 'हमने उछल- उछलकर ____' (both with odd hyphen spacing, kept as printed). The textbook has 'हमने उछल-उछलकर ...' as a पाठ 6 exercise. Open-ended.

blocks.label: प्रश्न 5.
blocks.instruction: दिए गए शब्दों से वाक्य बनाओ|
blocks.notes: धीरे- धीरे- / साथ- साथ / धन्यवाद (from the पाठ 7 exercise).

blocks.label: प्रश्न 6.
blocks.instruction: नीचे लिखे शब्दों को उनके अर्थों के साथ मिलाओ।
blocks.notes: The left column (बुद्धिमान, निस्संदेह, वृद्ध, श्रेष्ठ) is in printed order against the right column (बूढ़ा, विवेकवान, सर्वोत्तम, संदेह न होना). On paper the child draws lines, and on screen this becomes a match item. Marks split ½ × 4 (my split). Ends in danda । (not |).

blocks.label: प्रश्न 7.
blocks.notes: आज, नकली, पास, प्रसन्नता. Marks split ½ × 4 (my split). प्रसन्नता has several answers (अप्रसन्नता / दुख / उदासी).

blocks.label: प्रश्न 8.
blocks.instruction: तालिका को ध्यान से पढ़कर उचित वाक्य लिखिए-
blocks.notes: Tense (काल) sentence-writing: one sentence each in future, present and past. The table is on p3 and the instruction on p2. Open-ended; this is effectively sentence-making.

blocks.label: प्रश्न 9.
blocks.instruction: नीचे दी गई तालिका में नए शब्द बनाकर उनका वाक्यों में प्रयोग लिखो|
blocks.notes: Table उपसर्ग | मूल शब्द | नया शब्द | वाक्य. The blanks are भर+पेट→____ (भरपेट), अनु+____→अनुशासन (शासन), ____+विचार→सुविचार (सु), and each row also needs a sentence. Each item = fill + sentence, ½ + ½ suggested (my split).

blocks.label: प्रश्न 10.
blocks.instruction: नीचे दिए चित्र को पहचानकर नाम लिखो| इसके बारे में कोई तीन वाक्य लिखो|

pictures.what: black-and-white line drawing of a pillar-style post box (लेटर बॉक्स / पत्र-पेटी): domed top over a dark band, a dark mail slot, an envelope symbol on the front, solid black base

blocks.notes: Must be drawn as an original SVG, recognisable as a post box from the drawing alone. The child names it and writes 3 sentences. Name answers to accept: लेटर बॉक्स / पत्र-पेटी / डाक-पेटी / पोस्ट बॉक्स / लेटर-बॉक्स. Split suggested: name ½–1 + sentences (my split). The pictureAlt must not say 'लेटर बॉक्स'/'पत्र-पेटी'. (3M) is printed on its own line.

blocks.label: प्रश्न 11.
blocks.notes: Circling on paper; on screen this can become an MCQ / 'सही शब्द लिखिए' adaptation. The options are deliberate misspellings and must be copied exactly: क) प्रसानं / प्रसन्न / प्रसंन् ; ख) संग्रालय / संगृहलय / संग्रहालय. Answers: प्रसन्न, संग्रहालय. The labels are 'क)' and 'ख)' with no opening bracket. The heading is on p3 and the items on p4.

blocks.label: प्रश्न 12.
blocks.instruction: दिए गए अक्षरों से सार्थक शब्द बनाओ|
blocks.notes: क) ध / वे / ला / शा → वेधशाला (पाठ 6: जंतर-मंतर … इस वेधशाला). ख) र / द / बा / र → दरबार (पाठ 7). Spelling items, exact target.

blocks.label: प्रश्न 13.
blocks.instruction: नीचे लिखी पंक्तियों को साफ़ – साफ़ पुनः लिखो|
blocks.notes: सुलेख: copy a 4-line passage about विद्यार्थी जीवन में समय का महत्व onto the 10 printed lines. Paper-only, marked by the parent with a rubric (neatness, matras and शिरोरेखा, spelling, completeness). Has the en dash and nukta in 'साफ़ – साफ़'.

markArithmetic: No section headings; one section. Blocks: 5 + 6 (1+1+1+2+1, item marks only, no block total printed) + 2 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 5 = 40 = printed total (अंक- 40) ✔
issues: ws05 (3.1.5, Aug 2026, पाठ 6–7) repeats most of ws01's questions. Its transcript shows the same वाक्य बनाओ, tense table, उपसर्ग table, picture-identify, match, विलोम, गोला लगाओ, jumbled letters and सुलेख blocks, re-ordered under competency headings, plus an अपठित गद्यांश. The owner decides at Gate 0 whether to keep both (answers for shared questions must be consistent, Task 23) or drop one.
Q2 has no printed block total; the block marks (6) are derived from per-item (1M)/(2M). OK for the total, but the section/block marks are my sum, not printed.
Marks I split myself (each ⚑ per the brief): Q1 (घ)/(ड) two words each → ½ + ½; Q6 match ½ × 4; Q7 विलोम ½ × 4; Q9 fill + sentence ½ + ½; Q10 name + 3 sentences.
Paper-only candidates: Q13 सुलेख (5M, whole block) and Q11 गोला लगाओ (can be adapted to choose/write the correct word). Q6 line-matching can be done on screen as a match item.

Q10 needs an original post-box SVG that is recognisable from the drawing alone (pillar box, domed top, slot, envelope symbol). There are several acceptable names: लेटर बॉक्स / पत्र-पेटी / डाक-पेटी / पोस्ट बॉक्स.
Q1 (ग) 'जयपुर किस राज्य की राजधानी है?' and Q2 (ड) (उदयपुर झीलों का नगर क्यों) need general knowledge or inference beyond the passage, so both are ⚑.
Q1 passage is copied from पाठ 6 with small differences ('दाल- बाटी', 'शीश महल' spelled once with a space). Copy from the transcript, not the textbook.
